repos.name: deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
repos.description: DeepSeek Harness: Everything is a Plugin.
repos.one_liner: A modular, plugin-based architecture designed to extend the capabilities of DeepSeek models into a versatile agentic framework.
bullets: Built on a TypeScript-based plugin architecture that treats every capability as a modular component.
Serves as the core runtime for integrating LLM reasoning into complex, multi-step workflows.
Enables developers to build custom agentic behaviors by chaining plugins for specific tasks.
Provides a standardized interface for extending model functionality beyond simple text generation.

repos.name: truefoundry/trueforge
repos.description: The open-source agent harness - the runtime layer that turns an LLM into a working agent.
repos.one_liner: An open-source agent harness providing the essential runtime layer to transform raw LLMs into functional, autonomous agents.
bullets: Acts as the middleware between LLM providers and agentic execution environments.
Focuses on the infrastructure layer required to manage agent state, tool execution, and memory.
Designed to bridge the gap between experimental LLM prompts and production-grade agentic systems.
Provides a unified interface for developers to deploy and orchestrate agent workflows.

repos.name: yetone/cumora
repos.description: Where agent teams gather. Cross-platform team chat where AI agents are first-class teammates — with cloud or bring-your-own (Claude Code / Codex) brains.
repos.one_liner: A cross-platform team chat application where AI agents act as first-class, collaborative teammates.
bullets: Integrates AI agents directly into the communication flow, allowing them to participate in team discussions.
Supports flexible backend configurations including cloud-based models or local 'bring-your-own' brains like Claude Code.
Designed for collaborative agentic workflows where humans and AI co-develop software or manage projects.
Focuses on the human-agent interaction layer to improve team productivity and coordination.

repos.name: santifer/career-ops
repos.description: Open-source AI job search: scan job portals, evaluate listings with a structured A-F rubric into a 1.0-5.0 score, tailor your CV, track applications — runs locally in your AI coding CLI (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Antigravity…)
repos.one_liner: An AI-powered CLI tool that automates job searching, application tracking, and CV tailoring using structured evaluation rubrics.
bullets: Uses LLM-based analysis to score job listings on a 1.0-5.0 scale based on custom criteria.
Automates the tedious process of tailoring CVs to match specific job descriptions.
Operates locally within an AI coding CLI environment for privacy and seamless integration with development workflows.
Provides a structured, data-driven approach to the job hunting process for tech professionals.

repos.name: usestrix/strix
repos.description: Open-source AI penetration testing tool to find and fix your app’s vulnerabilities.
repos.one_liner: An open-source AI-driven penetration testing tool designed to identify and remediate application vulnerabilities.
bullets: Leverages LLM agents to automate the discovery of security flaws in application codebases.
Provides actionable remediation steps to fix identified vulnerabilities, reducing manual security overhead.
Focuses on the intersection of AI and DevSecOps to improve software infrastructure security.
Designed to be integrated into CI/CD pipelines for continuous security monitoring.

repos.name: trycompai/crm
repos.description: Comp AI CRM is an open source, CRM designed for AI agents. Agentic-first CRM.
repos.one_liner: An open-source, agent-first CRM designed specifically to manage and interact with AI agents.
bullets: Built with a modern TypeScript stack optimized for agentic workflows.
Provides a structured data layer for AI agents to read, write, and update customer relationship records.
Enables autonomous sales and support agents to maintain state and context across long-running interactions.
Designed to bridge the gap between traditional CRM data structures and LLM-based reasoning engines.

repos.name: kvcache-ai/AgentENV
repos.description: AgentENV (AENV) is a distributed platform for running agent environments at scale.
repos.one_liner: A distributed platform designed for running and scaling agent environments in production.
bullets: Written in Rust to ensure high-performance, memory-safe execution of agent environments.
Provides a distributed architecture to handle concurrent agent tasks at scale.
Focuses on the infrastructure layer required to manage stateful environments for AI agents.
Useful for developers building complex agentic systems that require consistent, isolated execution sandboxes.

repos.name: Blackwellboy/model-serving-minefield
repos.description: Community registry of LLM serving-path traps that produce confidently wrong measurements: templates, tool parsers, reasoning fields, quant kernel paths, CUDA toolchains, KV allocation, eval harnesses, versioning. Symptom-first, with the check that catches each.
repos.one_liner: A technical registry documenting common pitfalls and performance traps in LLM serving infrastructure.
bullets: Curates technical edge cases involving CUDA toolchains, KV cache allocation, and quantization kernels.
Serves as a diagnostic reference for engineers debugging 'confidently wrong' measurements in model serving.
Covers critical infrastructure components including tool parsers, reasoning fields, and evaluation harnesses.
Essential for finance and tech professionals building high-reliability AI systems where latency and accuracy are paramount.

repos.name: FareedKhan-dev/kimi-k3-in-c
repos.description: A 2.78-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 running inference on a single CPU in 8.24 GB of RAM. Portable C99: no BLAS, no framework, no GPU.
repos.one_liner: A highly optimized C99 implementation capable of running a 2.78-trillion-parameter model inference on a single CPU with minimal RAM.
bullets: Tech Structure: Pure C99 implementation with zero dependencies on BLAS, GPU frameworks, or external libraries.
Purpose: Demonstrates extreme hardware efficiency by running massive-scale models on standard consumer CPUs.
Use Cases: Ideal for edge computing, local privacy-focused inference, and reducing cloud infrastructure costs for large-scale model deployment.

repos.name: FedericoTs/quantprobe
repos.description: Run a 110B on a 2016 PC with 16 GB RAM. Know your tok/s before you download. Placement beats budget: predicts speed + memory fit for any GGUF on your exact hardware, self-calibrates, emits the exact llama.cpp command — or 'quantprobe auto' does it all. Falsification-tested laws; misses published at full size. pip install quantprobe
repos.one_liner: A diagnostic tool that predicts inference speed and memory fit for GGUF models on specific hardware configurations.
bullets: Tech Structure: Python-based benchmarking utility that self-calibrates against local hardware specs.
Purpose: Eliminates the guesswork in model deployment by calculating exact token-per-second performance before downloading large weights.
Use Cases: Essential for quant researchers and infrastructure engineers optimizing LLM serving costs on heterogeneous hardware.

repos.name: opensible/opensible
repos.description: An open source GitOps control plane for OpenTofu & Ansible - provision, configure and deploy across cloud, on-prem and hybrid, self-hosted and forever free.
repos.one_liner: An open-source GitOps control plane designed to unify OpenTofu and Ansible for hybrid cloud infrastructure management.
bullets: Tech Structure: Python-based orchestration engine providing a centralized control plane for infrastructure-as-code.
Purpose: Bridges the gap between provisioning (OpenTofu) and configuration management (Ansible) in a single GitOps workflow.
Use Cases: Automating complex multi-cloud deployments, enforcing infrastructure compliance, and managing on-premise to cloud migrations.

repos.name: YizhiSong/FriesTrader
repos.description: A fully automated AI trading agent that trades real Robinhood orders via its Agentic Trading MCP under mechanical, auditable risk rules the model cannot override. Once set up, it is able to run on its own schedule, screening and trading stocks under a narrow, explicit gate. Cheap to run — Claude Pro only, no metered API spend. Not financial advice.
repos.one_liner: A fully automated AI trading agent that executes real Robinhood orders via an Agentic Trading MCP with hard-coded, immutable risk constraints.
bullets: Tech Stack: Python-based agentic framework utilizing Model Context Protocol (MCP) for secure tool integration.
Purpose: To bridge the gap between autonomous AI decision-making and strict, auditable financial risk management.
Use Cases: Automated execution of trading strategies where the model's logic is constrained by non-overrideable safety rules.
Key Feature: Implements a 'mechanical' risk layer that prevents the AI from violating predefined capital protection parameters.

repos.name: drumih/turbo-fieldfare
repos.description: Gemma 4 26B-A4B inference in ~2 GB of RAM on any M-series MacBook
repos.one_liner: A highly optimized inference engine enabling Gemma 4 26B-A4B models to run on standard M-series MacBooks using only 2 GB of RAM.
bullets: Tech Stack: Written in Swift, leveraging low-level memory management and hardware-specific optimizations for Apple Silicon.
Purpose: To democratize access to high-parameter LLMs by drastically reducing the hardware requirements for local inference.
Use Cases: Running sophisticated AI models on consumer-grade laptops without cloud dependency or massive memory overhead.
Key Feature: Achieves extreme memory efficiency, allowing large-scale model deployment on devices previously considered incapable.

repos.name: crabbuild/compass
